functions.name: _Exit
functions.doc: Ends the program immediately with the given status, without running atexit handlers.

functions.name: __assert_fail
functions.prototype: void __assert_fail(const char *expr, const char *file, int line, const char *func)
functions.doc: Prints "Assertion failed: expr (file: func: line)" to stderr and aborts; called by the assert macro.

functions.name: abort
functions.doc: Ends the program abnormally with status 134, without running atexit handlers.

functions.name: abs
functions.doc: Returns the absolute value of an int.

functions.name: acos
functions.doc: Returns the arc cosine of x, in radians between 0 and pi.

functions.name: aligned_alloc
functions.doc: Allocates size bytes aligned to alignment (a power of two) and returns a pointer, or NULL.

functions.name: asctime
functions.doc: Formats *tm as "Www Mmm dd hh:mm:ss yyyy\n" in a static buffer and returns it.

functions.name: asin
functions.doc: Returns the arc sine of x, in radians between -pi/2 and pi/2.

functions.name: atan
functions.doc: Returns the arc tangent of x, in radians between -pi/2 and pi/2.

functions.name: atan2
functions.doc: Returns the arc tangent of y/x using the signs of both to pick the quadrant, in radians between -pi and pi.

functions.name: atexit
functions.doc: Registers a function for exit to call, in reverse order of registration; returns 0 on success.

functions.name: atof
functions.doc: Converts the start of a string to double (no error detection).

functions.name: atoi
functions.doc: Converts the start of a string to int (decimal, no error detection).

functions.name: atol
functions.doc: Converts the start of a string to long (decimal, no error detection).

functions.name: atoll
functions.doc: Converts the start of a string to long long (decimal, no error detection).

functions.name: bsearch
functions.prototype: void *bsearch(const void *key, const void *base, size_t count, size_t size, int(*cmp)(const void *, const void *))
functions.doc: Searches a sorted array for key with the comparison function cmp; returns the matching element or NULL.

functions.name: calloc
functions.doc: Allocates zeroed memory for count objects of size bytes each, or returns NULL if the total overflows or memory runs out.

functions.name: cbrt
functions.doc: Returns the cube root of x.

functions.name: ceil
functions.doc: Returns the smallest integer value not less than x.

functions.name: ceilf
functions.doc: Returns the smallest integer value not less than x (float).

functions.name: clearerr
functions.doc: Clears the end-of-file and error indicators of stream.

functions.name: clock
functions.doc: Returns processor time in CLOCKS_PER_SEC units; simulator instructions run at nominal 100 MHz. Returns -1 on overflow.

functions.name: copysign
functions.doc: Returns the magnitude of x with the sign of y.

functions.name: cos
functions.doc: Returns the cosine of x (radians).

functions.name: cosf
functions.doc: Returns the cosine of x in radians (float).

functions.name: cosh
functions.doc: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of x.

functions.name: ctime
functions.doc: Formats the time *t like asctime(localtime(t)).

functions.name: difftime
functions.doc: Returns end - start in seconds.

functions.name: div
functions.doc: Divides two ints, returning the quotient and remainder together.

functions.name: exit
functions.doc: Runs atexit handlers and static destructors, then ends the program with the given status.

functions.name: exp
functions.doc: Returns e raised to the power x.

functions.name: expf
functions.doc: Returns e raised to the power x (float).

functions.name: expm1
functions.doc: Returns e raised to the power x, minus 1, accurately even for x near 0.

functions.name: fabs
functions.doc: Returns the absolute value of x.

functions.name: fabsf
functions.doc: Returns the absolute value of x (float).

functions.name: fclose
functions.doc: Closes a stream opened by fopen and returns 0, or EOF on error.

functions.name: feof
functions.doc: Returns nonzero if the end-of-file indicator of stream is set.

functions.name: ferror
functions.doc: Returns nonzero if the error indicator of stream is set.

functions.name: fflush
functions.doc: Flushes pending output; NULL flushes all output streams. Returns 0, or EOF on failure.

functions.name: fgetc
functions.doc: Reads the next character from stream as an unsigned char converted to int, or returns EOF.

functions.name: fgetpos
functions.doc: Stores the current position of stream in *pos; returns 0, or -1 on error.

functions.name: fgets
functions.doc: Reads a line of at most n-1 characters, keeping the newline, into str; returns str, or NULL if nothing was read.

functions.name: floor
functions.doc: Returns the largest integer value not greater than x.

functions.name: floorf
functions.doc: Returns the largest integer value not greater than x (float).

functions.name: fmax
functions.doc: Returns the larger of x and y, ignoring a NaN argument.

functions.name: fmin
functions.doc: Returns the smaller of x and y, ignoring a NaN argument.

functions.name: fmod
functions.doc: Returns the remainder of x / y with the sign of x.

functions.name: fmodf
functions.doc: Returns the remainder of x / y with the sign of x (float).

functions.name: fopen
functions.doc: Opens the file at path with mode "r", "w" or "a" (optionally with "+", "b" or "x") and returns its stream, or NULL with errno set.

functions.name: fprintf
functions.doc: Writes formatted output to stream and returns the number of bytes written, or a negative value on error.

functions.name: fputc
functions.doc: Writes the character c to stream and returns it, or EOF on error.

functions.name: fputs
functions.doc: Writes the string str to stream without a newline; returns a non-negative value, or EOF on error.

functions.name: fread
functions.prototype: size_t fread(void *ptr, size_t size, size_t count, FILE *stream)
functions.doc: Reads up to count items of size bytes each into ptr and returns the number of complete items read.

functions.name: free
functions.doc: Releases a block returned by malloc, calloc, realloc or aligned_alloc; free(NULL) does nothing.

functions.name: freopen
functions.doc: Closes stream and opens path in its place, as fopen would; commonly used to read stdin from a File.

functions.name: frexp
functions.doc: Splits x into a fraction in [0.5, 1) returned and a power of two stored in *exp.

functions.name: fscanf
functions.doc: Reads formatted input from stream and returns the number of items assigned, or EOF if input ended before the first conversion.

functions.name: fseek
functions.prototype: int fseek(FILE *stream, long offset, int whence)
functions.doc: Moves the position of stream to offset from SEEK_SET, SEEK_CUR or SEEK_END; returns 0, or -1 on error.

functions.name: fsetpos
functions.doc: Moves stream to a position saved by fgetpos; returns 0, or -1 on error.

functions.name: ftell
functions.doc: Returns the current position of stream, or -1 on error.

functions.name: fwrite
functions.prototype: size_t fwrite(const void *ptr, size_t size, size_t count, FILE *stream)
functions.doc: Writes count items of size bytes each from ptr and returns the number of complete items written.

functions.name: getc
functions.doc: Reads the next character from stream, exactly like fgetc.

functions.name: getchar
functions.doc: Reads the next character from stdin, or returns EOF at the end of input.

functions.name: getenv
functions.doc: Always returns NULL: programs have no environment.

functions.name: gmtime
functions.doc: Breaks *t into UTC calendar fields stored in a static struct tm and returns it, or NULL on overflow.

functions.name: hypot
functions.doc: Returns sqrt(x*x + y*y) without undue overflow or underflow.

functions.name: imaxabs
functions.doc: Returns the absolute value of an intmax_t.

functions.name: imaxdiv
functions.doc: Divides two intmax_t values, returning the quotient and remainder together.

functions.name: isalnum
functions.doc: Returns nonzero if c is a letter or a digit.

functions.name: isalpha
functions.doc: Returns nonzero if c is a letter.

functions.name: isblank
functions.doc: Returns nonzero if c is a space or a tab.

functions.name: iscntrl
functions.doc: Returns nonzero if c is a control character.

functions.name: isdigit
functions.doc: Returns nonzero if c is a decimal digit.

functions.name: isgraph
functions.doc: Returns nonzero if c is printable and not a space.

functions.name: islower
functions.doc: Returns nonzero if c is a lowercase letter.

functions.name: isprint
functions.doc: Returns nonzero if c is printable, including the space.

functions.name: ispunct
functions.doc: Returns nonzero if c is printable but neither a space nor alphanumeric.

functions.name: isspace
functions.doc: Returns nonzero if c is white space: space, \t, \n, \v, \f or \r.

functions.name: isupper
functions.doc: Returns nonzero if c is an uppercase letter.

functions.name: isxdigit
functions.doc: Returns nonzero if c is a hexadecimal digit.

functions.name: labs
functions.doc: Returns the absolute value of a long.

functions.name: ldexp
functions.doc: Returns x multiplied by 2 raised to exp.

functions.name: ldiv
functions.doc: Divides two longs, returning the quotient and remainder together.

functions.name: llabs
functions.doc: Returns the absolute value of a long long.

functions.name: lldiv
functions.prototype: lldiv_t lldiv(long long num, long long den)
functions.doc: Divides two long longs, returning the quotient and remainder together.

functions.name: localtime
functions.doc: Same as gmtime: programs run in UTC.

functions.name: log
functions.doc: Returns the natural logarithm of x.

functions.name: log10
functions.doc: Returns the base-10 logarithm of x.

functions.name: log2
functions.doc: Returns the base-2 logarithm of x.

functions.name: logf
functions.doc: Returns the natural logarithm of x (float).

functions.name: malloc
functions.doc: Allocates size bytes of uninitialized memory and returns a pointer to it, or NULL with errno set to ENOMEM.

functions.name: memchr
functions.prototype: void *memchr(const void *s, int c, size_t n)
functions.doc: Returns a pointer to the first byte equal to c in the first n bytes of s, or NULL.

functions.name: memcmp
functions.prototype: int memcmp(const void *a, const void *b, size_t n)
functions.doc: Compares n bytes as unsigned chars; returns a negative, zero or positive value.

functions.name: memcpy
functions.doc: Copies n bytes from src to dest, which must not overlap, and returns dest.

functions.name: memmove
functions.doc: Copies n bytes from src to dest, which may overlap, and returns dest.

functions.name: memset
functions.doc: Fills n bytes at dest with the byte c and returns dest.

functions.name: mktime
functions.doc: Normalizes the fields of *tm, read as UTC, and returns the matching time_t, or -1 if it cannot be represented.

functions.name: modf
functions.doc: Splits x into an integral part stored in *ip and a fractional part returned, both with the sign of x.

functions.name: perror
functions.doc: Writes msg, a colon and the message for the current errno to stderr.

functions.name: pow
functions.doc: Returns x raised to the power y.

functions.name: powf
functions.doc: Returns x raised to the power y (float).

functions.name: printf
functions.doc: Writes formatted output to stdout and returns the number of bytes written, or a negative value on error.

functions.name: putc
functions.doc: Writes the character c to stream, exactly like fputc.

functions.name: putchar
functions.doc: Writes the character c to stdout and returns it, or EOF on error.

functions.name: puts
functions.doc: Writes the string str and a newline to stdout; returns a non-negative value, or EOF on error.

functions.name: qsort
functions.prototype: void qsort(void *base, size_t count, size_t size, int(*cmp)(const void *, const void *))
functions.doc: Sorts count elements of size bytes at base in place using the comparison function cmp.

functions.name: rand
functions.doc: Returns a pseudo-random integer between 0 and RAND_MAX.

functions.name: realloc
functions.doc: Resizes the block at ptr to size bytes, moving it if needed; returns the new pointer, or NULL leaving the block unchanged.

functions.name: rewind
functions.doc: Moves stream back to its start and clears its error indicator.

functions.name: round
functions.doc: Returns x rounded to the nearest integer value, halfway cases away from zero.

functions.name: roundf
functions.doc: Returns x rounded to the nearest integer value, halfway cases away from zero (float).

functions.name: scalbn
functions.doc: Returns x multiplied by 2 raised to n.

functions.name: scanf
functions.doc: Reads formatted input from stdin and returns the number of items assigned, or EOF if input ended before the first conversion.

functions.name: setbuf
functions.doc: Requests full output buffering with BUFSIZ bytes, or unbuffered output when buf is NULL.

functions.name: setvbuf
functions.prototype: int setvbuf(FILE *stream, char *buf, int mode, size_t size)
functions.doc: Sets output buffering (_IOFBF, _IOLBF or _IONBF); input buffering is unsupported. Returns 0, or nonzero on failure.

functions.name: sin
functions.doc: Returns the sine of x (radians).

functions.name: sincos
functions.doc: Stores the sine and cosine of x (radians) in *s and *c (GNU extension; GCC may combine sin and cos calls into it).

functions.name: sincosf
functions.doc: Stores the sine and cosine of x in radians in *s and *c (float, GNU extension).

functions.name: sinf
functions.doc: Returns the sine of x in radians (float).

functions.name: sinh
functions.doc: Returns the hyperbolic sine of x.

functions.name: snprintf
functions.prototype: int snprintf(char *str, size_t n, const char *format, ...)
functions.doc: Writes at most n-1 formatted characters into str plus a NUL and returns the length the full output would have had.

functions.name: sprintf
functions.doc: Writes formatted output into str with a terminating NUL and returns the number of characters written.

functions.name: sqrt
functions.doc: Returns the square root of x, correctly rounded.

functions.name: sqrtf
functions.doc: Returns the square root of x, correctly rounded (float).

functions.name: srand
functions.doc: Seeds the sequence returned by rand; the same seed repeats the same sequence.

functions.name: sscanf
functions.doc: Reads formatted input from the string str and returns the number of items assigned.

functions.name: strcat
functions.doc: Appends the string src to the end of dest and returns dest.

functions.name: strchr
functions.doc: Returns a pointer to the first occurrence of the character c in s (c may be NUL), or NULL.

functions.name: strcmp
functions.doc: Compares two strings; returns a negative, zero or positive value.

functions.name: strcoll
functions.doc: Compares two strings in the "C" locale, exactly like strcmp.

functions.name: strcpy
functions.doc: Copies the string src, including its NUL, to dest and returns dest.

functions.name: strcspn
functions.doc: Returns the length of the initial part of s containing no character from reject.

functions.name: strdup
functions.doc: Returns a malloc'ed copy of the string s, or NULL if memory runs out.

functions.name: strerror
functions.doc: Returns a message describing the error number errnum.

functions.name: strlen
functions.doc: Returns the length of the string s, not counting its terminating NUL.

functions.name: strncat
functions.doc: Appends at most n characters of src, then a NUL, to dest and returns dest.

functions.name: strncmp
functions.prototype: int strncmp(const char *a, const char *b, size_t n)
functions.doc: Compares at most n characters of two strings; returns a negative, zero or positive value.

functions.name: strncpy
functions.doc: Copies at most n characters of src to dest, padding with NULs; dest is not terminated if src is n or longer. Returns dest.

functions.name: strndup
functions.doc: Returns a malloc'ed copy of at most n characters of s, always terminated, or NULL if memory runs out.

functions.name: strnlen
functions.doc: Returns the length of s, but at most n.

functions.name: strpbrk
functions.doc: Returns a pointer to the first character of s that is in accept, or NULL.

functions.name: strrchr
functions.doc: Returns a pointer to the last occurrence of the character c in s, or NULL.

functions.name: strspn
functions.doc: Returns the length of the initial part of s made only of characters in accept.

functions.name: strstr
functions.doc: Returns a pointer to the first occurrence of the string needle in haystack, or NULL.

functions.name: strtod
functions.doc: Converts the start of a string to double, correctly rounded, storing the end in *end; sets errno to ERANGE on overflow or underflow.

functions.name: strtof
functions.doc: Converts the start of a string to float, correctly rounded, storing the end in *end; sets errno to ERANGE on overflow or underflow.

functions.name: strtoimax
functions.prototype: intmax_t strtoimax(const char *str, char * *end, int base)
functions.doc: Converts the start of a string to intmax_t in the given base (0 detects 0x and 0 prefixes), storing the end in *end.

functions.name: strtok
functions.doc: Splits a string into tokens separated by characters in delim; pass the string first, then NULL to continue.

functions.name: strtol
functions.prototype: long strtol(const char *str, char * *end, int base)
functions.doc: Converts the start of a string to long in the given base (0 detects 0x and 0 prefixes), storing the end in *end; sets errno to ERANGE on overflow.

functions.name: strtoll
functions.prototype: long long strtoll(const char *str, char * *end, int base)
functions.doc: Converts the start of a string to long long in the given base, storing the end in *end; sets errno to ERANGE on overflow.

functions.name: strtoul
functions.prototype: unsigned long strtoul(const char *str, char * *end, int base)
functions.doc: Converts the start of a string to unsigned long in the given base, storing the end in *end; sets errno to ERANGE on overflow.

functions.name: strtoull
functions.prototype: unsigned long long strtoull(const char *str, char * *end, int base)
functions.doc: Converts the start of a string to unsigned long long in the given base, storing the end in *end; sets errno to ERANGE on overflow.

functions.name: strtoumax
functions.prototype: uintmax_t strtoumax(const char *str, char * *end, int base)
functions.doc: Converts the start of a string to uintmax_t in the given base (0 detects 0x and 0 prefixes), storing the end in *end.

functions.name: strxfrm
functions.prototype: size_t strxfrm(char *dest, const char *src, size_t n)
functions.doc: Copies src into dest (at most n bytes) in the "C" locale and returns the length of src.

functions.name: tan
functions.doc: Returns the tangent of x (radians).

functions.name: tanf
functions.doc: Returns the tangent of x in radians (float).

functions.name: tanh
functions.doc: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of x.

functions.name: time
functions.doc: Returns the current time in seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC and also stores it in *t when t is not NULL.

functions.name: tolower
functions.doc: Returns the lowercase form of c if it is an uppercase letter, otherwise c.

functions.name: toupper
functions.doc: Returns the uppercase form of c if it is a lowercase letter, otherwise c.

functions.name: trunc
functions.doc: Returns x rounded toward zero to an integer value.

functions.name: truncf
functions.doc: Returns x rounded toward zero to an integer value (float).

functions.name: ungetc
functions.doc: Pushes the character c back onto stream so the next read returns it; returns c, or EOF on failure.

functions.name: vfprintf
functions.prototype: int vfprintf(FILE *stream, const char *format, va_list ap)
functions.doc: Like fprintf, with the arguments taken from a va_list.

functions.name: vfscanf
functions.prototype: int vfscanf(FILE *stream, const char *format, va_list ap)
functions.doc: Like fscanf, with the arguments taken from a va_list.

functions.name: vprintf
functions.doc: Like printf, with the arguments taken from a va_list.

functions.name: vscanf
functions.doc: Like scanf, with the arguments taken from a va_list.

functions.name: vsnprintf
functions.prototype: int vsnprintf(char *str, size_t n, const char *format, va_list ap)
functions.doc: Like snprintf, with the arguments taken from a va_list.

functions.name: vsprintf
functions.prototype: int vsprintf(char *str, const char *format, va_list ap)
functions.doc: Like sprintf, with the arguments taken from a va_list.

functions.name: vsscanf
functions.prototype: int vsscanf(const char *str, const char *format, va_list ap)
functions.doc: Like sscanf, with the arguments taken from a va_list.
